message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff. She examined the clay beneath the foundation. The rain softened the red earth. He measured the distance between the posts. A hammer tapped the wooden beams. The moss grew green over the stones. They stacked bricks near the doorway. The staff hummed with quiet power. Pebble Spring smiled at the finished wall. The family watched from the porch. The roof caught the morning light. She placed a flower in the window. The door swung gently on new hinges. The garden fence followed the old path. The smoke rose from the hearth. A cat sat on the new sill. The children named the little house. The neighbors brought bread and salt. The Leshy felt warmth in the walls. Pebble Spring knew home was a growing thing. The old gardener noticed every leaf, stone, window, door, path, fence, garden, wall, roof, beam, nail, plank, tool, cart, bucket, shovel, trowel, spade, mattock, ax, hammer, saw, chisel, drill, brace, rope, line, level, ruler, spotty stone.
